assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities and engineering constraints remain unverified.
assumptions.impact: This package is a reviewable urban-design concept, not a statutory, ownership, permitting or construction conclusion.

assumptions.statement: The site and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional geometry; all derived areas and ratios describe this submission geometry only.
assumptions.impact: Replace the polygons and recompute every geometry-derived metric after official redlines are released.

assumptions.statement: Persona journeys and time gains express relative pressure only; no unsupported minutes are assigned.
assumptions.impact: The proposal compares mechanisms and failure paths but does not claim a measured time saving.

assumptions.statement: Audit, care, human-service, data-governance and evaluation operators are unverified candidate roles.
assumptions.impact: No public body, institution, company or community group is presented as a committed operator, funder or service provider.

assumptions.statement: The fairness metrics have definitions but no frozen review window, complete event logs, denominator coverage or group-level test sample.
assumptions.impact: All six formally compatible fairness metrics remain unknown/null; targets are design gates, not measured performance.

assumptions.statement: The formal metrics schema does not accept minutes_per_journey.
assumptions.impact: METRIC-AVOIDABLE-TIME-BURDEN stays blocked in the module-07 catalog and is omitted from metrics.json rather than disguised as ratio or none.
